item.title: LG 48” B6 OLED and 5 more new deals
item.description:
6 new deals this morning, each one checked by hand.

LG 48” Class B6 OLED 4K Smart webOS TV (2026) at Best Buy
LG’s 2026 entry OLED in the 48-inch size, half off its comparable value at Best Buy. A real OLED picture for a bedroom, office or gaming desk without a giant screen.

LEGO Icons Bonsai Tree Building Set (10281) at Walmart
An 878-piece display set with swappable green leaves and pink cherry blossoms. A relaxing evening build for an adult, and it looks good on a shelf afterwards.

De’Longhi Stilosa Espresso Machine, Matte Black at Walmart
A compact 15-bar pump espresso machine with a manual frother for milk drinks. The lowest-cost proper espresso machine from a big brand on our list this weekend.

JBL Flip 7 Portable Waterproof Speaker at Walmart
JBL’s waterproof, drop-proof Bluetooth speaker with about 16 hours of play, marked as a Black Friday Deal. It’s sold by an authorized JBL dealer on Walmart’s marketplace, so check the seller and pick a new unit, not open box.

Blink Mini 2K+ Indoor Security Camera at Amazon
Amazon’s newest small plug-in camera records in 2K and has a built-in spotlight for night. It’s an easy way to keep an eye on a pet, a door or a nursery.

Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K at Amazon
Plugs into any HDMI port and turns an older TV into a 4K streamer with the main apps and an Alexa voice remote. One of the easiest small gifts in Amazon’s sale this weekend.
